line.a_staw.text: Fox, come here! This is the magic pond. Look at yourself in the water!

line.a_takie_samo.text: I can see myself in the water! My reflection is just the same as me.

line.a_uwaznie.text: At a first glance, yes. But this pond plays tricks: it always changes something. You must look carefully.

line.a_znajdz.text: Look at Fox and at his reflection. Point to what is different.

line.a_bez_szalika.text: Oh my! My reflection has no scarf!

line.a_roznica.text: That is a difference: something that is not the same in two pictures. Looking for differences is a fun game!

line.a_jeszcze.text: Let's do it again! I'll put on a hat and glasses.

line.a_dwie.text: Now the pond changed two things. Find both differences.

line.a_dwie_zamiana.text: My reflection has no glasses, and a winter hat instead of my hat! What a clever pond.

line.b_gra.text: The pond shows us two pictures of the meadow, but it changed something on one of them. Look at a bit of one picture, then at the same place on the other. Find three differences.

line.b_gra_ok.text: All three found! You have sharp eyes.

line.b_rysunek.text: Oh dear, trouble! I drew a card for my granny, and the pond made a copy of it. Now I have two, and I don't know which is mine.

line.b_pomoge.text: We'll help you! Let's find the differences between the drawings.

line.b_ktory.text: My drawing had a kitten and a sun with rays. Point to the drawing that is mine.

line.b_ktory_nie.text: This one has no kitten and no rays. It's the pond's copy. Which one is the real one?

line.b_moj.text: That's my drawing! Thank you, granny will be so happy.

line.b_do_domu.text: Let's go home before it gets dark. Tonight I'm sleeping over at your place, Fox!

line.p_start.text: Let's train our sharp eyes! I have five games.

line.p_para_ogrodek.text: Two pictures of the garden. Find three differences.

line.p_para_plaza.text: Two pictures of the beach. Find three differences.

line.p_para_pokoik.text: Two pictures of a room. Find three differences.

line.p_zapamietaj.text: Look carefully at these things and remember them.

line.p_zamknij.text: And now close your eyes! No peeking.

line.p_co_zniknelo.text: Up in the row one thing is missing. Something was where the question mark is. Point to what has gone.

line.p_co_zniknelo_nie.text: Not that one. Look at the row: which thing isn't there any more?

line.p_co_zniknelo_ok.text: Yes! That's what disappeared. Well remembered.

line.p_inny.text: Four shadows. Point to the one that is not like the others.

line.p_inny_nie.text: This shadow is the same as the others. Look for the one that's different.

line.p_inny_ok.text: Yes! That's a pear, and the rest are apples.

line.d_zapamietaj.text: Look carefully at where everything is, and remember it.

line.d_zamknij.text: Now it's your turn! Close your eyes and I'll move something.

line.d_co.text: Two toys have swapped places. Point to one of them.

line.d_nie.text: This toy is where it was. Which one moved?

line.d_tak.text: Yes, the teddy and the block swapped places! Granny plays tricks, just like the pond.

line.d_rodzice.text: Play it at home with your parents: one closes their eyes, the other moves one thing. What has changed?

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for finding my drawing! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Granny Owl's feather. She left it to say thank you when we were spotting differences.

line.d_druga.text: Now point to the one it swapped with.

line.d_druga_nie.text: That one is in its own place. Which other one moved?

line.p_jeszcze_raz.text: Once more! Remember all the things in the row.

line.b_do_babci.text: Let's take the card to your granny! Lead the way, Owl.

line.c_dab.text: Here we are! My granny lives in this old oak. Can you see the little round door high up in the trunk? That's her home.

line.c_zapukaj.text: Let's knock! Granny will see what a lovely card you have for her.

line.c_spi.text: Shh! Granny sleeps in the daytime, because owls stay awake at night. I'll leave the card by her door. She'll find it this evening.

line.c_czeka.text: The card is waiting for Granny. What a surprise she'll have!

line.b_rybki.text: Look, a fish is swimming in the pond! It is hungry. Let's give it some bread to say thank you for the game.

line.b_rybki_jak.text: Slide the bread to the fish with your finger. But don't give it the pine cone!

line.b_rybki_ok.text: The fish is full! Thank you, pond.

line.c_droga.text: Granny's oak grows far away, beyond the brook, on a little hill. Let's follow the path!

line.c_strumyk.text: Oh no, a brook! And there are no stones to step on.

line.c_kamienie.text: Here are some flat stones. Put them in the water, in the marked places.

line.c_hop.text: Hop, hop, hop! We're on the other side.

line.c_widac.text: Can you see the big oak on the hill? That's where Granny lives!

line.d_wieczor.text: What a day! Tonight I'm sleeping over at Fox's. And tonight Granny will find my drawing.

line.d_przyleci.text: I'm sure she'll fly over to say thank you. Owls fly at night!

line.d_plan.text: Then let's tidy up and remember where everything is. In the morning we'll see if anything has changed!

line.d_poloz.text: Put the teddy, the ball and the block on the rug, side by side.

line.d_noc.text: Look! Granny opened her little door and found the drawing. How happy she is!

line.d_rano.text: Good morning! Everything is the same as yesterday. I don't think Granny came.

line.d_uwaznie.text: At a glance, yes. But look carefully, just like at the pond!

line.d_nowe.text: But something here is new. Point to what was not in the room yesterday.

line.d_nowe_nie.text: That was here yesterday. What wasn't here yesterday?

line.d_pioro.text: A grey feather! It's my granny's feather. She was here in the night and left it to say thank you!

line.d_jak_babcia.text: Let's play like Granny! Owl, close your eyes and I'll move something.

line.d_sowa_znalazla.text: Let me look. The teddy is sitting somewhere else! Found it.

line.d_ktora.text: Open your eyes! Point to what has moved.

line.d_ktora_nie.text: That is where it was. What has moved?

line.d_ktora_ok.text: Yes, the ball! I rolled it off the rug onto the floor.

line.b_roznice_ok.text: Three differences: the kitten, the sun's rays and the colour of the door!

line.d_pierwsza_ok.text: Yes, this toy is somewhere else than in the evening!
